full_prompt_en: A tall comic-book panel depicts a quiet lane leading between a small white cottage and dense purple flowering trees. A dark green roof and simple window appear at the left edge, while lush lavender and violet foliage fills the right side and curls overhead. The lane narrows toward a pale opening in the distance, creating a gentle central perspective. Above it, flat lilac sky and cream-colored clouds form broad graphic shapes. A few dark line details pick out branches and foliage, but most forms are built from compact inked color patches rather than soft painterly blending. A small bird crosses the open sky, adding a light point of motion to the still landscape. The panel is framed by a crisp white gutter and a thin dark border, making its vertical composition feel like one moment in a longer illustrated sequence. Purple takes up most of the picture, while the roof's cool green and the cottage's light wall provide clear contrast. The ink texture has subtle print grain and slightly uneven edges. The whole scene feels cheerful yet calm, with a clean comic hierarchy, stylized vegetation, and a path that invites the eye deeper into the panel.
full_prompt_zh: 一个纵向漫画分格描绘一条安静小径，延伸在白色小屋与密集紫色花树之间。左缘露出深绿色屋顶和简单窗户，右侧被茂盛的薰衣草紫与深紫树冠填满，并向上弯入画框。小路向远处浅色开口收窄，形成柔和中央透视。上方平涂的淡紫天空与奶油色云朵组成宽阔图形色面。少量深色线条勾出树枝和树叶，但大多数形状由紧密的墨色块面构成，而非柔软绘画晕染。一只小鸟掠过开放的天空，为静止风景添了轻微运动。画格由清晰白色沟槽和细黑边框包围，使纵向构图像长篇插画叙事中的一个瞬间。紫色占据画面大部分，屋顶的冷绿和小屋浅色墙面提供清楚对比。墨色表面带细微印刷颗粒和略不均匀的边缘。整体明快却安静，具有清晰漫画层级、风格化植被与引视线深入画格的小路。
style_prompt_en: A colorful comic-print style builds scenes from clear bordered panels, compact inked color shapes, and readable perspective. Saturated violet and lavender can occupy broad areas, balanced by small cool green and warm cream accents. Fine dark contours define selected edges while large shapes stay flat and graphic. Stylized foliage or other clustered texture gains depth through overlapping patches rather than gradients. A narrow path or comparable receding line leads the eye toward a pale opening. White gutters, thin border lines, light print grain, and slightly imperfect ink edges preserve the feel of a printed story page. The mood is bright, calm, and gently inviting.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色漫画印刷风格以清晰分格边框、紧密墨色块面和易读透视构成场景。饱和深紫与薰衣草紫可占据大面积，由少量冷绿和暖乳白平衡。细深色轮廓界定精选边缘，大形体保持平面而图形化。风格化叶丛或其他密集纹理由重叠色块取得纵深，而非渐变。一条窄路或类似后退线引视线通往浅色开口。白色分格沟槽、细边框、轻微印刷颗粒和略不完美的墨边保留印刷故事页的感觉。气氛明快、平静、温和地邀请观看。
theme_en: A purple flowering lane between a cottage and trees in a comic panel
theme_zh: 漫画分格中，紫色花树与小屋之间的一条幽径
name: Comic strip style
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
